messages:
Nina: quick UX review note: the inline docs panel we added to the model page is inconsistent with the help flyout. panel heading says 'Model settings' while docs.site and action buttons say 'Model details'. can we pick one term?

Omar: +1. pick 'Model details' — matches docs.site and is clearer for customers. I'll grep for 'Model settings' and update strings in Console.

Claire: accessibility catch: when panel opens from the top-right kebab, focus lands on the panel container but not on the heading. screen reader users hear nothing. we should focus the heading and add aria-labelledby.

Ben: small dev note: current code uses `openDocsPanel(anchor)` which navigates to `/models/:id/docs` causing a full route swap. change to pushState + mount panel to preserve UI state (filters, time-range).

A11yBot: automated scan results: missing aria-labelledby on panel, external links lack `aria-label="opens in new tab"`, and contrast on the inline callout badge is 3.4:1 on dark theme (needs 4.5:1).

Nina: UX asks: 1) harmonize copy across Console and docs.site to 'Model details' 2) ensure deep-links into docs open the panel and highlight the section (outline + aria-live announce) 3) restore focus to triggering element on close.

Omar: plan: intercept internal doc links, pushState({openDocs:section}), mount panel, save `document.activeElement` as `lastActive` and on close `lastActive?.focus()` with a small rAF. add heading id and aria-labelledby + aria-live region for deep links.

Claire: tests: e2e keyboard flow (open via keyboard, navigate inside, esc -> focus restored), screen reader manual check, and color token change for badge to meet contrast.

Ben: I'll open PR `fix/docs-panel-model-details-1812` with string updates, focus restoration, and external link aria. will include changelog note for bookmarked full-docs URLs.

Nina: thanks — please post staging link and a 6s screencap showing keyboard open -> esc -> focus restored for docs screenshots. tagging @design for visual QA. :sparkles:
